caption:
Watch what happens when a kid picks the "wrong" answer. 👀

Nothing breaks. Nobody's scolded. It just says "Not quite, try again!" and lets them try. That's the whole idea: a safe place to practice a big feeling before it happens for real. 💛

A friendly voice reads every word, and the kid makes the choices. 🔊👆 No reading required, and six full stories are free forever, no sign-up at all.
▶️ mccraylearninglab.com (IG: link in bio)
notes: Audience: kids 7-11. Music: cheerful, light percussion. 20.6s.
